Infant Nutrition
Nutrition for the Premature Infant
Optimal nutrition is critical in the management of pre-term infants.1 Although no 
standard exists for the precise nutritional needs of infants born prematurely, current 
recommendations are developed to simulate the in-utero growth rate. Breast milk or 
fortified breast milk is considered ideal for the pre-term infant. Human milk fortifiers
